hooks.command: degraded_status() { printf '%s\n' '<career_status>' "status_bar: unavailable${1:+ ($1)}" 'Execution gates and deadlines were NOT checked.' '</career_status>'; }; plugin_root="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; status_bar="${plugin_root}/scripts/status_bar.py"; if [ -z "$plugin_root" ] || [ ! -f "$status_bar" ]; then degraded_status 'plugin script unavailable'; exit 0; fi; if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then degraded_status 'python3 command unavailable'; exit 0; fi; status_output="$(python3 "$status_bar" 2>/dev/null)"; status_code=$?; if [ "$status_code" -eq 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$status_output"; else degraded_status 'runtime failure'; fi; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: function Write-DegradedStatus([string]$Reason = 'plugin script unavailable') { Write-Output '<career_status>'; Write-Output ('status_bar: unavailable (' + $Reason + ')'); Write-Output 'Execution gates and deadlines were NOT checked.'; Write-Output '</career_status>' }; $pluginRoot = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($pluginRoot)) { Write-DegradedStatus 'plugin root unavailable'; exit 0 }; $statusBar = Join-Path -Path $pluginRoot -ChildPath 'scripts/status_bar.py'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $statusBar -PathType Leaf)) { Write-DegradedStatus 'plugin script unavailable'; exit 0 }; $python = Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($null -eq $python) { Write-DegradedStatus 'python command unavailable'; exit 0 }; $exitCode = 1; $statusOutput = $null; try { $statusOutput = (& $python.Source $statusBar 2>$null | Out-String -Width 4096); $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE } catch { $exitCode = 1 }; if ($exitCode -eq 0) { [Console]::Out.Write($statusOutput) } else { Write-DegradedStatus 'runtime failure' }; exit 0
